name: Urteste S.A.
summary: Urteste S.A. focuses on the investigation and development of diagnostic solutions designed to detect various forms of cancer. Their portfolio includes testing methods for a wide range of malignancies affecting organs such as the pancreas, prostate, kidneys, colon, liver, biliary system, stomach, lungs, esophagus, ovaries, endometrium, blood, breasts, and the nervous system. This enterprise, based in Gdansk, Poland, commenced its operations in 2021.
